b: \( a^{m}a^{n}=a^{m+n} \), \( a^{-n}=\tfrac{1}{a^{n}} \), \( a^{1/n}=\sqrt[n]{a} \). Quadratic formula \( x=\dfrac{-b\pm\sqrt{b^{2}-4ac}}{2a} \); the discriminant \( b^{2}-4ac \) fixes the number of real roots.

b: \( \sin^{2}\theta+\cos^{2}\theta=1 \) and \( \tan\theta=\dfrac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta} \). Exact values: \( \sin30^{\circ}=\tfrac12 \), \( \cos30^{\circ}=\tfrac{\sqrt3}{2} \), \( \sin60^{\circ}=\tfrac{\sqrt3}{2} \). The sine and cosine curves have period \( 360^{\circ} \).

b: \( \dfrac{d}{dx}x^{n}=nx^{n-1} \); the gradient at a point is the value of \( \tfrac{dy}{dx} \) there. Integration reverses this: \( \displaystyle\int x^{n}\,dx=\dfrac{x^{n+1}}{n+1}+C \) for \( n\neq-1 \).

f_ar: الحدس المفاهيمي العميق — Differentiation و Integration
b: Accumulation, Antiderivatives & Differential Flows: By the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus, the accumulation function \(A(x) = \int_a^x f(t)\,dt\) satisfies \(A'(x) = f(x)\), linking instantaneous rates of change to net signed area. In first-order differential equations \(\dfrac{dy}{dx} = g(x)h(y)\), separation of variables \(\int \dfrac{1}{h(y)}\,dy = \int g(x)\,dx + C\) reconstructs the family of integral curves across the slope field.

In first-order differential equations \(\dfrac{dy}{dx} = g(x)h(y)\), separation of variables \(\int \dfrac{1}{h(y)}\,dy = \int g(x)\,dx + C\) reconstructs the family of integral curves across the slope field.
